en: The image is a vintage postcard depicting a rural landscape with a dirt path, a man standing next to a horse, another horse grazing, and a small dog. On the left is a house with a red-tiled roof surrounded by greenery and trees. In the background, a large building is visible atop a hill, suggesting a scenic countryside setting. The bottom of the postcard contains printed text in Dutch, and there is handwriting with a date on the lower right.
